<style>.lx-el.e-con{--padding-top:0px;--padding-right:0px;--padding-bottom:0px;--padding-left:0px;--gap:0px;--row-gap:0px;--column-gap:0px;padding:0}.lx-el>.elementor-widget-html,.lx-el .elementor-widget-container{margin:0;padding:0}</style>
<!--
  NEUROGENOMIC · Landing 3D «De la mirada a la decisión»
  Un solo cuerpo de partículas cuenta toda la historia sin cortes:
  0 NEUROGENOMIC (marca) → 1 neurona → 2 señales → 3 IA → 4 seis servicios → 5 persona → 6 fijación (decisión).
  Gramática de movimiento única (ver CRITICA-ANIMACIONES.md):
   · una curva de entrada: --lx-out cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)
   · un gesto de llegada: cuando la figura termina de formarse, una onda lima la recorre y,
     en el mismo instante, la línea de medición del texto se dibuja y el titular sube por líneas
   · morph guiado por el scroll, barrido de izquierda a derecha (como un escáner)
  Sin menú, sin GSAP ni Lenis: scroll nativo, un solo bucle rAF y transiciones CSS reversibles.
-->
<style>
@font-face{font-family:'Big Shoulders Display';font-style:normal;font-weight:400;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}@font-face{font-family:'Schibsted Grotesk';font-style:normal;font-weight:400;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}@font-face{font-family:'Schibsted Grotesk';font-style:normal;font-weight:500;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}@font-face{font-family:'Schibsted Grotesk';font-style:normal;font-weight:600;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}@font-face{font-family:'Martian Mono';font-style:normal;font-weight:400;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}@font-face{font-family:'Martian Mono';font-style:normal;font-weight:500;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
:root{
  --lx-bg:#050607;--lx-tx:#F2F3F0;--lx-tx2:#A3A8B0;--lx-line:rgba(255,255,255,.1);
  --lx-lime:#C8FF00;--lx-s1:#0D0F11;
  --lx-disp:'Big Shoulders Display','Arial Narrow Bold',Impact,sans-serif;
  --lx-ff:'Schibsted Grotesk',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;
  --lx-mono:'Martian Mono',ui-monospace,'SFMono-Regular',Menlo,monospace;
  --lx-out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);
  --lx-gut:clamp(18px,4.4vw,72px);
}
html:has(.lx){scroll-behavior:auto;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body:has(.lx){margin:0;background:var(--lx-bg)}
.lx{position:relative;font:400 16px/1.55 var(--lx-ff);color:var(--lx-tx);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;-moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale}
.lx *,.lx *::before,.lx *::after{box-sizing:border-box}
/* Blindaje ante el tema de WordPress (Hello Elementor y similares) */
.lx :where(h1,h2,h3,p,ul,ol,li,figure){margin:0;padding:0;font-size:inherit;font-weight:inherit;line-height:inherit;color:inherit;font-family:inherit;letter-spacing:inherit}
.lx :where(ul,ol){list-style:none}
.lx :where(a){color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.lx :where(a):is(:hover,:focus,:active){color:inherit}
.lx :where(button){font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:0;padding:0;margin:0;border-radius:0;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:inherit}
.lx :where(button):is(:hover,:focus){background:none;color:inherit}
.lx :where(input){font:inherit;margin:0}
.lx :where(label){display:revert;font-weight:inherit;line-height:inherit}
.lx :focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--lx-lime);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:2px}
.lx ::selection{background:var(--lx-lime);color:#050607}
.lx-sr{position:absolute!important;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}

/* ---------- Escena fija ---------- */
.lx-stage{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;background:var(--lx-bg)}
.lx-stage__glow{position:absolute;inset:-10%;
  background:radial-gradient(42% 38% at var(--gx,50%) 46%,rgba(200,255,0,.07),transparent 70%),
             radial-gradient(60% 50% at 50% 120%,rgba(120,140,160,.10),transparent 70%)}
.lx-stage__cv{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;opacity:0;transition:opacity .9s var(--lx-out)}
.lx-gl .lx-stage__cv{opacity:1}
.lx-stage__vig{position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(120% 95% at 50% 45%,transparent 55%,rgba(0,0,0,.72))}
.lx-lbl{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font:500 11px/1 var(--lx-mono);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--lx-tx);white-space:nowrap;opacity:0;will-change:transform}
.lx-lbl::before{content:"";flex:0 0 auto;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lx-lime);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(200,255,0,.9)}
.lx-lbl span{padding:5px 7px;border:1px solid rgba(200,255,0,.35);border-radius:3px;background:rgba(5,6,7,.78);opacity:0;transform:translateX(-6px);transition:opacity .3s var(--lx-out),transform .3s var(--lx-out)}
.lx-lbl.is-on{opacity:1}
.lx-lbl.is-l{flex-direction:row-reverse}
.lx-lbl.is-l span{transform:translateX(6px)}
.lx-lbl.is-on span{opacity:1;transform:none;transition-duration:.7s;transition-delay:var(--d,0ms)}

/* ---------- Estructura de scroll: cada capítulo fija su cuadro mientras la figura se forma ---------- */
.lx-sec{position:relative;z-index:1;height:210vh;height:210svh}
.lx-hero{height:175vh;height:175svh}
.lx-frame{position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;height:100svh;display:flex;align-items:center;overflow:hidden}
.lx-frame::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .8s var(--lx-out);
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(5,6,7,.88) 0%,rgba(5,6,7,.55) 34%,transparent 58%)}
.lx-sec[data-side="r"] .lx-frame::before{background:linear-gradient(270deg,rgba(5,6,7,.88) 0%,rgba(5,6,7,.55) 34%,transparent 58%)}
.lx-sec.is-in .lx-frame::before{opacity:1}
.lx-txt{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:min(600px,46vw);margin-left:var(--lx-gut);padding-block:40px}
.lx-sec[data-side="r"] .lx-txt{margin-left:auto;margin-right:calc(var(--lx-gut) + 40px)}

/* ---------- Tipografía ---------- */
.lx-k{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font:500 11px/1.4 var(--lx-mono);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--lx-tx2);padding-bottom:14px}
.lx-k b{font-weight:500;color:var(--lx-lime)}
/* Línea de medición: se dibuja en el mismo instante en que la figura 3D termina de formarse */
.lx-k::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;width:min(100%,420px);height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--lx-lime),rgba(200,255,0,.15));transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:0 50%;transition:transform .4s var(--lx-out)}
.is-in .lx-k::after{transform:scaleX(1);transition-duration:1.1s}
.lx-h{margin:clamp(12px,2.2vh,22px) 0;font:400 min(clamp(54px,6.6vw,128px),11.5vh)/.88 var(--lx-disp);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:-.005em}
.lx-h em{font-style:normal;color:var(--lx-lime)}
.lx-ln{display:block;overflow:hidden;padding:.06em 0 .04em;margin:-.06em 0 -.04em}
.lx-ln>span{display:block}
.lx-p{font-size:clamp(17px,1.3vw,19.5px);line-height:1.52;color:#DADDE2;font-weight:400;max-width:50ch}
.lx-p strong{color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.lx-list{margin-top:24px;border-top:1px solid var(--lx-line)}
.lx-list li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:34px 1fr;gap:10px;align-items:baseline;padding:clamp(6px,1.2vh,11px) 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--lx-line);font-size:15.5px;color:#DADDE2}
.lx-list li b{font:500 11px/1 var(--lx-mono);letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--lx-lime)}
.lx-list li strong{color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.lx-list--svc li{grid-template-columns:34px minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.25fr)}
.lx-list--svc li i{font-style:normal;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--lx-tx2)}
.lx-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:22px}
.lx-chips li{font:500 11px/1 var(--lx-mono);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:8px 9px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid rgba(200,255,0,.32);color:var(--lx-tx)}
.lx-note{margin-top:16px;font:400 11px/1.55 var(--lx-mono);letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--lx-tx2);max-width:56ch}

/* ---------- Botones (mismo sistema que el sitio) ---------- */
.lx-btn{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;min-height:54px;padding:0 24px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);font:500 15px/1 var(--lx-ff);white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .2s ease,border-color .2s ease,box-shadow .3s var(--lx-out),transform .16s var(--lx-out)}
.lx-btn:active{transform:scale(.97)}
.lx-btn--volt{background:var(--lx-lime);border-color:var(--lx-lime);color:#050607!important;font-weight:600;box-shadow:0 12px 36px -14px rgba(200,255,0,.7)}
.lx-btn i{font-style:normal;display:inline-block;transition:transform .3s var(--lx-out)}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){
  .lx-btn:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
  .lx-btn--volt:hover{background:#D9FF4D;border-color:#D9FF4D;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(200,255,0,.16),0 16px 42px -12px rgba(200,255,0,.8)}
  .lx-btn:hover i{transform:translate(3px,-2px)}
}
.lx-ctas{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:28px}

/* ---------- Gramática de revelado (única para todo el sitio) ----------
   Entrada: 0,9–1 s con --lx-out, escalonada 70–80 ms. Salida: 0,4 s, misma curva.
   Son transiciones (no keyframes): si el usuario vuelve atrás a mitad de camino, se revierten desde donde estaban. */
.lx-js .lx-r{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(0,22px,0);transition:opacity .4s var(--lx-out),transform .4s var(--lx-out)}
.lx-js .is-in .lx-r{opacity:1;transform:none;transition-duration:.9s;transition-delay:calc(var(--i,0) * 70ms + 160ms)}
.lx-js .lx-ln>span{transform:translate3d(0,108%,0);transition:transform .4s var(--lx-out)}
.lx-js .is-in .lx-ln>span{transform:none;transition-duration:1s;transition-delay:calc(var(--i,0) * 80ms)}
.lx-js .lx-sec.is-out .lx-txt{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(0,-18px,0)}
.lx-txt{transition:opacity .45s var(--lx-out),transform .45s var(--lx-out)}

/* ---------- Hero: solo la marca, en grande ---------- */
.lx-hero .lx-frame{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;justify-content:space-between;padding:clamp(18px,2.4vw,34px) var(--lx-gut) clamp(22px,3vw,40px)}
.lx-hero .lx-frame::before{display:none}
.lx-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;font:500 11px/1.4 var(--lx-mono);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--lx-tx2)}
.lx-top b{font-weight:500;color:var(--lx-tx)}
.lx-top>span{white-space:nowrap}
@media (max-width:1199px){.lx-top>span:last-child{display:none}}
.lx-rec{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:var(--lx-tx)}
.lx-rec::before{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lx-lime);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(200,255,0,.9)}
.lx-mark{position:relative;display:block;margin:0;font:400 clamp(60px,15.6vw,330px)/.86 var(--lx-disp);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0;white-space:nowrap;text-align:left;
  color:var(--lx-tx);transition:opacity .2s linear}
.lx-mark>span{display:inline-block;line-height:.86}
.lx-mark__b{color:var(--lx-lime)}
/* Con WebGL las partículas rellenan las letras y el texto HTML queda como contorno nítido */
.lx-gl .lx-mark>span{color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(242,243,240,.5)}
.lx-gl .lx-mark__b{-webkit-text-stroke-color:rgba(200,255,0,.55)!important}
.lx-js .lx-mark{opacity:0}
.lx-js .lx-hero.is-ready .lx-mark{opacity:var(--mo,1);transition:opacity .9s var(--lx-out)}
.lx-js .lx-hero.is-set .lx-mark{transition:none}
.lx-hero__foot{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:end;gap:24px}
.lx-claim{font:400 clamp(26px,2.6vw,46px)/1 var(--lx-disp);text-transform:uppercase;max-width:20ch}
.lx-claim em{font-style:normal;color:var(--lx-lime)}
.lx-sub{margin-top:14px;font-size:clamp(15px,1.15vw,17px);color:var(--lx-tx2);max-width:46ch}
.lx-cue{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:12px;font:500 10px/1 var(--lx-mono);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--lx-tx2)}
.lx-cue i{position:relative;width:1px;height:54px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);overflow:hidden}
.lx-cue i::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-1px;top:0;width:3px;height:16px;background:var(--lx-lime);animation:lx-cue 1.8s var(--lx-out) infinite}
@keyframes lx-cue{from{transform:translateY(-16px)}to{transform:translateY(54px)}}
.lx-js .lx-hero .lx-r{transition-delay:calc(var(--i,0) * 80ms)}

/* ---------- HUD: capítulo actual + progreso (sustituye al menú) ---------- */
.lx-hud{position:fixed;left:var(--lx-gut);bottom:clamp(14px,2vw,26px);z-index:20;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;font:500 11px/1 var(--lx-mono);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--lx-tx2);opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px);transition:opacity .4s var(--lx-out),transform .4s var(--lx-out);pointer-events:none}
.lx-hud.is-on{opacity:1;transform:none}
.lx-hud b{font-weight:500;color:var(--lx-lime);min-width:5ch}
.lx-hud__bar{position:relative;width:min(160px,22vw);height:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);overflow:hidden}
.lx-hud__bar i{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--lx-lime);transform-origin:0 50%;transform:scaleX(var(--p,0))}
.lx-hud__n{display:inline-block;min-width:12ch;color:var(--lx-tx)}
.lx-pause{position:fixed;right:var(--lx-gut);bottom:clamp(10px,1.6vw,22px);z-index:20;display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:0 14px!important;border-radius:999px!important;border:1px solid rgba(242,243,240,.22)!important;background:rgba(5,6,7,.7)!important;color:var(--lx-tx)!important;font:500 10.5px/1 var(--lx-mono)!important;letter-spacing:.1em!important;text-transform:uppercase!important;cursor:pointer;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .4s var(--lx-out),border-color .2s ease,visibility 0s linear .4s}
.lx-pause.is-on{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transition:opacity .4s var(--lx-out),border-color .2s ease}
.lx-pause i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lx-lime)}
.lx-pause[aria-pressed="true"] i{background:transparent;border:1px solid rgba(242,243,240,.7)}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.lx-pause:hover{border-color:var(--lx-lime)!important}}

/* ---------- CTA ---------- */
.lx-cta{height:auto;min-height:150vh;min-height:150svh}
.lx-cta .lx-frame{min-height:100vh;min-height:100svh;height:auto;overflow:visible}
.lx-cta .lx-h{font-size:min(clamp(48px,5.4vw,104px),10vh)}
.lx-form{margin-top:30px;max-width:540px;padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid var(--lx-line)}
.lx-form__l{display:block;font:500 11px/1.4 var(--lx-mono);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--lx-tx2);margin-bottom:12px}
.lx-form__row{display:flex;border:1.5px solid rgba(242,243,240,.6);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;background:rgba(13,15,17,.85);transition:border-color .2s ease,box-shadow .3s var(--lx-out)}
.lx-form__row:focus-within{border-color:var(--lx-lime);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(200,255,0,.12)}
.lx-form__row.is-err{border-color:#FF6B57}
.lx-form input[type=email]{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;min-height:56px;padding:0 16px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--lx-tx);font:400 16px/1 var(--lx-ff);outline:0;box-shadow:none;border-radius:0}
.lx-form input[type=email]::placeholder{color:var(--lx-tx2)}
.lx-form button{flex:0 0 auto;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:0 20px;background:var(--lx-lime)!important;color:#050607!important;font:600 15px/1 var(--lx-ff);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .2s ease}
.lx-form button[disabled]{opacity:.6;cursor:progress}
.lx-form__ck{display:flex!important;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;margin-top:12px;color:var(--lx-tx2);font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.45;cursor:pointer}
.lx-form__ck input{flex:0 0 auto;width:18px;height:18px;margin:1px 0 0;accent-color:#C8FF00}
.lx-form__ck a{display:inline;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:2px}
.lx-form__st{min-height:1.4em;margin-top:10px;font-size:14px;color:var(--lx-tx2)}
.lx-form__st.is-ok{color:var(--lx-lime)}.lx-form__st.is-err{color:#FF8A78}
.lx-form.is-sent .lx-form__row,.lx-form.is-sent .lx-form__ck{display:none!important}
.lx-rules{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 14px;margin-top:26px;font:500 10.5px/1.5 var(--lx-mono);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--lx-tx2)}
.lx-rules li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.lx-rules li::before{content:"";width:10px;height:1px;background:#FF6B57}

.lx-foot{position:relative;z-index:1;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px 24px;padding:26px var(--lx-gut) 90px;border-top:1px solid var(--lx-line);background:rgba(5,6,7,.92);font:500 10.5px/1.6 var(--lx-mono);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--lx-tx2)}
.lx-foot a{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}

/* ---------- Demo · Así mira tu cliente (eye tracking sobre la bolsa MESTA, marca ficticia) ----------
   Tres pasos conducidos por el scroll; cada animación muestra exactamente lo que dice su texto:
   1 qué se mide (fijaciones en orden + activación) · 2 qué revela (mapa de calor, zonas ciegas, pico) · 3 qué decisión permite. */
.lx-demo{position:relative;z-index:1;height:440vh;height:440svh}
.lx-demo .lx-frame{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:clamp(24px,4vw,72px);padding:0 var(--lx-gut)}
.lx-demo .lx-frame::before{background:rgba(5,6,7,.72)}
.lx-demo.is-in .lx-frame::before{opacity:1}
.lx-demo .lx-txt{z-index:1;margin:0;max-width:520px;padding:0}
.lx-dm-steps{margin-top:clamp(14px,2.4vh,26px);border-top:1px solid var(--lx-line)}
.lx-dm-step{position:relative;padding:clamp(10px,1.8vh,16px) 0 clamp(10px,1.8vh,16px) 46px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--lx-line);opacity:.38;transition:opacity .35s var(--lx-out)}
.lx-dm-step.is-on{opacity:1}
.lx-dm-step b{position:absolute;left:0;top:clamp(12px,2vh,18px);font:500 11px/1 var(--lx-mono);letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--lx-tx2)}
.lx-dm-step.is-on b{color:var(--lx-lime)}
.lx-dm-step h3{font:600 clamp(16px,1.25vw,19px)/1.2 var(--lx-ff);color:#fff}
.lx-dm-step p{margin-top:6px;font-size:clamp(14.5px,1.05vw,16px);line-height:1.5;color:#C9CDD3}
.lx-dm-step i{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:-1px;height:1px;background:var(--lx-lime);transform-origin:0 50%;transform:scaleX(var(--sp,0))}
.lx-dm-res{display:grid;gap:6px;margin-top:10px;font:500 10.5px/1.4 var(--lx-mono);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--lx-tx2)}
.lx-dm-res li{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:baseline;opacity:0;transform:translateX(-6px);transition:opacity .3s var(--lx-out),transform .3s var(--lx-out)}
.lx-dm-res li.is-on{opacity:1;transform:none;transition-duration:.6s}
.lx-dm-res li span{flex:0 0 auto;padding:3px 6px;border-radius:3px;color:#050607;font-weight:600}
.lx-dm-res .k-p{background:var(--lx-lime)}.lx-dm-res .k-a{background:#FFC93D}.lx-dm-res .k-d{background:#FF6B57}
.lx-dm-note{margin-top:12px;font:400 10.5px/1.5 var(--lx-mono);letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--lx-tx2)}
/* Escenario */
.lx-dm-stage{position:relative;z-index:1;width:min(48vw,calc((86vh - 150px) * .952),640px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:10px;background:rgba(8,9,10,.85);overflow:hidden}
.lx-dm-bar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:10px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--lx-line);font:500 10.5px/1.2 var(--lx-mono);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--lx-tx2)}
.lx-dm-bar b{font-weight:500;color:var(--lx-lime);white-space:nowrap}
.lx-dm-view{position:relative;aspect-ratio:800/840;overflow:hidden}
.lx-dm-view svg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.lx-dm-cell{transition:none}

        ' if(i==0){if(aE.y<.5){a=.85;return WHITE;}if(aE.y<1.5){a=.95;return LIME;}a=.22;return DUST;}',

        ' float k=aE.x;if(k<.5){a=.85;return LIME;}if(k<1.5){a=.7;return WHITE;}if(k<2.5){a=.8;return WHITE;}if(k<3.5){a=1.;return vec3(1.,.3,.08);}',

    group.add(new T.Points(geo, mat));

    /* --- Etiquetas HTML ancladas a la figura --- */
    var LBL = [
      [1, 'Soma', [somaA[0], somaA[1] + .62, 0]], [1, 'Sinapsis', term],

      [5, 'Producto', CARDS[0]], [5, 'Mensaje', CARDS[1]], [5, 'Canal', CARDS[2]], [5, 'Contexto', CARDS[3]],

      return { k: l[0], el: el, v: new T.Vector3(l[2][0], l[2][1], l[2][2]) };
    });
    var tmp = new T.Vector3();

    var DUSTK = [null, function (o) { return aD[o + 1] < 0; }, function (o) { return aK[o] > 3.5; }, function (o) { return aK[o + 1] > 2.5; },
                 function (o) { return aK[o + 2] > 2.5; }, function (o) { return aK[o + 3] > 2.5; }, function (o) { return aE[o] > 4.5; }];
    var BOX = [{ cx: 0, cy: 0, w: 1, h: 1 }];
    for (var s = 1; s < STN; s++) {

      var q = function (a, t) { return a[Math.floor((a.length - 1) * t)]; }, x0 = q(xs, .02), x1 = q(xs, .98), y0 = q(ys, .02), y1 = q(ys, .98);
      if (s === 2) x0 = Math.max(x0, -6.2); // las corrientes de señales pueden entrar desde fuera del cuadro

    }
    var txtH = [];
    var measureTxt = function () { secs.forEach(function (el, i) { var t = el.querySelector('.lx-txt'); txtH[i] = t ? t.offsetHeight : 0; }); };
    measureTxt();
    // Encuadre en píxeles: la figura ocupa el centro del espacio que deja libre el texto (al lado en horizontal, arriba en vertical)
    var place = function (i, stack) {
      if (i === 0) return [0, 0, 1];
      var W = innerWidth, H = innerHeight, wpp = 2 * CAMZ[i] * Math.tan(FOV * Math.PI / 360) / H, b = BOX[i], cx, cy, fw, fh;
      if (stack) {
        var top = 60, bottom = i < 6 ? H - txtH[i] : H * .42;
        fw = W * .94; fh = Math.max(H * .24, bottom - top); cx = W / 2; cy = top + fh / 2;
      } else {
        var gut = clamp(W * .044, 18, 72), tw = Math.min(600, W * .46) + 40;
        fw = W - gut * 1.5 - tw; fh = H * .8; cx = SIDE[i] > 0 ? gut + tw + fw / 2 : W - gut - tw - fw / 2; cy = H / 2;
      }
      var k2 = stack ? .84 : .9, sc = Math.min(fw * wpp * k2 / b.w, fh * wpp * k2 / b.h, 1);
      return [(cx - W / 2) * wpp - b.cx * sc, (H / 2 - cy) * wpp - b.cy * sc, sc];
    };
    var cur = { stage: 0, off: 0, y: 0, sc: 1, z: CAM0, alpha: 1 }, mx = 0, my = 0, tmx = 0, tmy = 0, mouseIn = 0, mouseT = 0;
    var ray = new T.Raycaster(), ndc = new T.Vector2(), plane = new T.Plane(), hit = new T.Vector3(), nrm = new T.Vector3();
    if (FINE) {
      addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) { tmx = e.clientX / innerWidth - .5; tmy = e.clientY / innerHeight - .5; ndc.set(e.clientX / innerWidth * 2 - 1, -(e.clientY / innerHeight) * 2 + 1); mouseIn = 1; kick(); }, { passive: true });
      d.addEventListener('pointerleave', function () { mouseIn = 0; });
    }
    var size = function () {
      var w = innerWidth, h = innerHeight; renderer.setSize(w, h, false); camera.aspect = w / h; camera.updateProjectionMatrix();

    var rt = 0;
    addEventListener('resize', function () { size(); clearTimeout(rt); rt = setTimeout(function () { fitMark(); buildWord(); measureTxt(); LBL.forEach(function (l) { l.w = 0; }); kick(); }, 180); kick(); });

    var ip = function (arr, s) { var i = Math.min(arr.length - 2, Math.floor(s)), f = s - i; return arr[i] + (arr[i + 1] - arr[i]) * f; };

      renderer.render(scene, camera);
      syncText(cur.stage);
      tickClock(now);
      var hw = innerWidth / 2, hh = innerHeight / 2;
      LBL.forEach(function (l) {
        var on = Math.abs(cur.stage - l.k) < .1 && cur.alpha > .7;
        if (on) {
          tmp.copy(l.v).applyMatrix4(group.matrixWorld).project(camera);
          if (tmp.z > 1 || Math.abs(tmp.x) > 1.02 || Math.abs(tmp.y) > 1.02) on = false;
          else {
            // Si la etiqueta no cabe a la derecha del punto (borde de pantalla o columna de texto), se dibuja a la izquierda
            var px = tmp.x * hw + hw, lw = l.w || (l.w = l.el.offsetWidth), lim = isStack() || SIDE[l.k] > 0 ? innerWidth - 8 : innerWidth - clamp(innerWidth * .044, 18, 72) - Math.min(600, innerWidth * .46) - 48;
            var left = px + lw > lim;
            if (l.left !== left) { l.left = left; l.el.classList.toggle('is-l', left); }
            l.el.style.transform = 'translate3d(' + (left ? px - lw : px).toFixed(1) + 'px,' + (-tmp.y * hh + hh).toFixed(1) + 'px,0)';
          }
